brief: 24 Hours in Tech roundup: 16:9 YouTube, no captions, brand intro after the cold open (when inbox/brand/Intro.mp4 exists), a story counter so viewers know where they are (chapter rail, 'Story 3 of 8'), a NewsCard with the real source for every story, SFX on story changes, cut audio mistakes; no BGM; English

list.name: newsroom
list.brief: daily news-desk look, the same every day so the channel is recognisable: news screenshots and NewsCards lead (the real source of each story), a story counter / chapter rail, split-screen framing, high-contrast accent; punchy pace, a beat every 3-5 s; a wipe whoosh + hit on every story change, soft ticks elsewhere
